patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layout for project showcases, featuring project details on the left and corresponding visual mockups or screenshots on the right, often within a dark, framed container.
Strong typographic contrast between large, elegant serif fonts for primary headings and display text, and clean, modern sans-serif fonts for body copy, labels, and functional elements.

A minimalist base of white and dark grey/black is consistently used for backgrounds and primary text, with vibrant electric blue and a playful lime green serving as distinct accent colors for interactive elements and emphasis.

Fixed bottom navigation elements are present on both the homepage and interior pages, adapting their content and styling per page. No scroll-triggered content reveals, parallax, or other animations are discernible on the homepage from the provided static images.

The 'Projects' section employs a unique presentation where each project entry is a distinct block with a textual summary on one side and a visual representation on the other, creating a dynamic yet structured portfolio display.

technique_notes: Typography is built on a high-contrast pairing: a large, expressive serif font for impactful headlines and a clean, legible sans-serif for all supporting text, ensuring both visual flair and readability.

The color scheme uses a stark white background with deep charcoal or black text, accented by a bright, electric blue for calls-to-action and a specific lime green for playful emphasis, creating a modern and energetic feel.

A sticky navigation bar is anchored to the bottom of the viewport, which dynamically changes its internal links and visual presentation (e.g., button styles, presence of an 'X' close icon) based on the specific page being viewed.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and even smaller uppercase labels for details.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements and image containers, with predominantly sharp edges for overall layout.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, leaning towards airy in hero and testimonial sections, with a tighter grid in the project list.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly elegant, large serif typeface for primary headings, contrasted with a modern sans-serif, creates a sophisticated yet approachable feel. This typographic hierarchy, combined with a minimalist color palette punctuated by a vibrant electric blue and a playful green, gives the site a unique blend of classic editorial design and contemporary digital flair. The dynamic, context-aware sticky bottom navigation is also a notable feature.
